answer: Mechanism: an attestation bridge using a saffron bond token. Each agent registers a hardware-rooted key; validators compute a unique-entropy score and threshold-sign a Merkle root. Registration burns a bond proportional to claimed reputation; duplicate keys trigger slashing. A whisper gossip layer propagates revocation proofs. Attacker cost: burned bond, failed validator quorum, and scarce hardware, making mass fake identities expensive.
